As promised, I will let you fight God. Come, then, to the 'Land of Origin'.

Of course I have not given up on the coming of the 'New World'. // But I find I wish to test it: this truth they speak of. // [1]Besides, that one has earned the right.

You will not be scorned for the color of your hair. [1]You will shed no tears of loneliness. Yes, the world you long for is there.
Too bad for you. A world like that doesn't interest me.
Do you fear losing your body? The body is but a chain that binds the soul. // Only by severing that chain can one at last gain true freedom, unbound by the fear of death and age.

You went to the trouble of darkening the whole stage and showing me my childhood memories, just to spout that drivel? // What poor taste you people have. I'm tired of it.
